title: Clarify the keyed session-switch boundary in the marker-history callback test
outcome: The centered-history callback regression makes its lifecycle coverage explicit: same-session renders exercise callback reference stability; changing activeSessionId exercises SessionConversationPage's keyed remount. Readers do not mistake this for dependency invalidation across IDs inside one mounted page.
acceptance: The focused callback test or adjacent test documentation explicitly states that switching session IDs remounts SessionConversationPage, so the switched-ID leg checks per-instance reference and ID forwarding rather than the hook dependency list across one mounted instance.
